plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
database: none of its own: the stores use tables in each product's PostgreSQL database through the product's openvibe-sdk/db handle (ADR-035); DDL from schema(prefix) in the product's migrations
consumers: OpenVibe.Wiki (v0.4.0 on SQLite until it moves to 1.x; public at https://openvibe.wiki)
OpenVibe.Blog (v0.4.0 on SQLite until it moves to 1.x; public at https://openvibe.blog)
OpenVibe.News (v0.4.0 on SQLite until it moves to 1.x; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
OpenVibe.Reviews (v0.4.0 on SQLite until it moves to 1.x; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
OpenVibe.Deals (v0.4.0 on SQLite until it moves to 1.x; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
OpenVibe.Coupons (v0.4.0 on SQLite until it moves to 1.x; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
OpenVibe.Trade (v0.4.0 on SQLite until it moves to 1.x; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
contracts: openvibe-contracts v0.49.0 (devDependency): emits search.index-document@1 and events.event-envelope@1 (validated in tests)
tests: npm test (Node 22): 16 files, 121 cases; test/postgres.test.js runs on PostgreSQL 18 + PgBouncer when OV_TEST_PG_URL is set (CI starts the containers), else it is listed as skipped
deployment: none: a package released as git tags; products pin the tag and deploy it with their own releases
features: async stores on PostgreSQL through openvibe-sdk/db, with the caller's transaction handle, schema(prefix) DDL for migrations, indexes for every query and bounded, keyset-paged lists
revisions with optimistic concurrency, diff and revert
Media attachment references with honest broken states
deterministic indexability gate, redirects, sitemaps and feeds
authorship and AI disclosure, held until a person's review
Search index documents, tombstones and publication events
auto-escaping SSR and a safe Markdown subset
